program:
-- called by: DisplayResults(table)
param word:string,str:string -> string
var html_marking:="<mark>"+str+"</mark>"

var titleCase:=strToUpper(strCopy(str,1,1))+strCopy(str,2,strlen(str)-1)
var html_marking_title:="<mark>"+titleCase+"</mark>"

var html_text:string:=regex_replace(word,str,html_marking)
html_text:=regex_replace(html_text,titleCase,html_marking_title)

return html_text
